safety_security_measures_007.answer: yes. Measures: Mandatory ID badge display for employees; visitors must sign in at the main office and be escorted. Reporting channels/obligations: Direct unauthorized individuals to the building office/administrator and contact security dispatch at 972-494-8201. Building access controls are referenced, with staff instructed not to disclose system failures publicly.
safety_security_measures_007.evidence: All visitors are expected to enter any district facility through the main entrance and sign in or report to the building’s main office... contact security dispatch at 972-494-8201... All GISD employees are required to prominently display their badge on their person

safety_weapons_008.answer: yes. Prohibition: Employees, visitors, and students are banned from bringing firearms, knives, clubs, or prohibited weapons on school premises or activity grounds. Reporting duty: Observed/suspected violations must be reported to supervisors, GISD Security (972-494-8911), or 911. Exceptions: Board-authorized possession; employees with a Texas handgun license may store an unloaded, locked firearm in a locked district parking area/vehicle if not in plain view; District-approved supervised activities.
safety_weapons_008.evidence: prohibited from bringing firearms, knives, clubs, or other prohibited weapons onto school premises... employees who observe or suspect a violation... should report it to their supervisors or call GISD Security at 972-494-8911... stores a handgun or other firearm in a locked vehicle in a parking lot... provided the handgun or other firearm is not loaded and not in plain view
